title: BCR Repertoire Analysis and Cloning of Antibody Candidates Targeting Native and Asp7-Isomerized β-Amyloid.

title: WTAP/m6A/YTHDF1-mediated upregulation of Midkine expression drives clear cell renal cell carcinoma metastasis: insights from single-cell sequencing.
snippet: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC) is the most common subtype of kidney cancer. It is highly heterogeneous and exhibits a pronounced tendency towards haematogenous metastasis, which together contribute to poor overall survival. The molecular and cellular programs that distinguish metastatic from non-metastatic primary ccRCC remain incompletely defined....
